name: Content Draggable
description: Provides an admin content view where nodes can be click-and-drag reordered using DraggableViews.
project_description:
The "Content Draggable" module introduces an interactive and dynamic feature to Drupal sites, allowing users to engage with web elements through a click-and-drag interface. This module is designed to enhance user experience by making content more interactive. With "Content Draggable," site builders and content managers can easily define elements within their Drupal site that users can click on and move around the screen. This functionality can be particularly useful for educational websites, interactive dashboards, and applications that benefit from a more engaging and hands-on approach to content presentation.

 Dependecey -

To install “Content Draggable” module, ensure you also need install this composer require drupal/draggableviews module as a dependency.

 Installation Steps:

 • Go to the Extend page (/admin/modules) in your Drupal admin area.

 • Click on "Install new module" and upload the module package or specify the URL to the module. Alternatively, if the module is already in your file system, locate it in the list.

• User can access this feature on UI by going to the following path: /admin/admin-content-draggable.

 Post-Installation

 There is no configuration, the module will creates automatically a custom view for this module, you can add the fields as per your requirements.
